_note: The floor for THE FRAME STANDS IN A PLACE, read by scripts/carousel/depth_floor.py. Both numbers are the HIGH WATER MARK of what this machine has actually built, never an aspiration, for the reason run_complete.ratchet_floor states at length: a number typed today is a guess about a machine that is supposed to be improving. Raise them when the corpus clears them comfortably. Lowering either is a decision somebody makes out loud, never a fix for a red build.

derived_from.why_5_and_4: 2026-09-13 reached 5 staged frames and 5 distinct cues in one real run, so 5 staged is the high water mark rather than a stretch. Cues sit one under that high water at 4, deliberately: the fifth cue is where a frame gets to make a choice, and a quota met by reaching for whatever is cheapest is not the same thing as a frame that needed it.
